basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old web developer from Indianapolis. My interests include classic cars, especially beetles, and exploring new music genres. I have a particular fondness for 90s music, which I often discuss on Reddit. I work remotely, which gives me the flexibility to browse Reddit throughout the day. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time gaming or attending local car meets. I'm active on Reddit mainly during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Purdue University. I've been working in web development for over 15 years, primarily self-taught through online courses and forums. My expertise lies in front-end development, but I have a decent understanding of back-end technologies as well.
